worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.summary: A steel punch fired on the spot and driven straight through: zero preparation (it strikes on commit), the user never moves, and the steel fist pierces along a narrow line, skewering whoever is lined up in front of it. The steel round settles on a lower defence coefficient. The armour-piercing form adds one more pierce (up to 3 with Speed) at a lighter hit, shorter reach and a higher cost.
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.use.0: An instant steel first strike at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.use.1: Punch through a front and back foe lined up together
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.use.2: Poke and shove without moving from the spot
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.descriptio: The fist deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block reach and a %3$s block half-width line; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Pierce up to %1$s foes along your aim, shoving each about %2$s blocks.
The steel round is harder than ordinary physical moves and settles on a lower defence coefficient, so heavy Defence stops it less.
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.ap.on: Armour-piercing: one more pierce (up to 3 with Speed) so a longer line can be punched through, at 0.85 damage, 0.3 blocks less reach, 1 tick more preparation, 2 ticks more recovery and 6 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.ap.off: Solid round: a single steel punch with longer reach, a faster recovery and a harder hit.
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.growth.0: At level %1$s the punch rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.growth.1: At level %1$s the punch rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bulletpunch.preference: On: one more pierce (up to 3 with Speed) so a longer line can be punched through, but 0.85 damage, 0.3 blocks less reach, 1 tick more preparation, 2 ticks more recovery and 6 ticks more cooldown. Off: a single solid punch with longer reach, a faster recovery and a harder hit.
